faqs.question: Which management package is right for me?
faqs.answer: Core covers everyday coordination. Signature adds reporting, lease administration and one annual inspection. Prestige builds on Signature with two annual inspections in total, planning and enhanced reporting. We can help match the scope to your property and preferred involvement.

faqs.question: How does percentage-based pricing work?
faqs.answer: Signature is 5.5% of monthly rent with a $179 monthly minimum. Prestige is 7.5% with a $269 monthly minimum. At $3,000 monthly rent, the minimum applies to both. Core is a flat $159 per month. The estimator shows management fees only; final terms are confirmed in your quote.

faqs.question: Are maintenance and repair costs included?
faqs.answer: Coordination is included according to your package. Repairs, contractor charges and materials are paid separately by the property owner. Approval arrangements and the scope of emergency coordination are confirmed before service begins.

faqs.question: Can you help find a tenant?
faqs.answer: Tenant Placement & Leasing is available for 60% of one month's rent. The proposed workflow covers consultation, rental marketing, enquiries, application review and move-in coordination. We confirm the marketing, screening and showing arrangements with you before starting.

faqs.question: What happens if rent is late?
faqs.answer: All three plans include rent tracking and late rent follow-up. Signature and Prestige also include LTB administrative coordination. This is not legal advice or legal representation. Filing fees and legal or enforcement costs are separate, and outcomes are not guaranteed.

faqs.question: How often is my property inspected?
faqs.answer: Signature includes one property inspection per year; Prestige includes two per year in total. Additional inspections are $129 each. Move-in or move-out inspections are separate add-ons at $129. Access and scheduling are subject to applicable requirements and the agreed service scope.

faqs.question: Do you manage properties outside the GTA?
faqs.answer: Our focus is the Greater Toronto Area, with services available across Ontario on a property-specific basis. Tell us your location so we can confirm the available service scope, local support and any on-site requirements.
